g.text: Request timeline and adapter payload path
one LoRA request, adapter already in CPU memory: the copy hides behind text encoding; VAE and encoding leave the denoise batch
batch keeps denoising other requests (no stall)
E2E = queue_wait + adapter_wait + text_encode + Σ step_time(bs, k_distinct) + vae_decode + image_encode + transfer
bars L1 LoRA/base P50 ≤ 1.10× · L2 P99 mixed/keyed ≤ 0.5× · L3 adapter_wait P90 ≤ 1 step · L4 load ≤ 10 ms · L5 VAE off path
per layer: A[r, d_in] | B[d_out, r]
GPU slots: A_stack / B_stack, every layer
payload ≈ r × 13.3 MB for a Qwen-Image-like DiT, all linears (≈ 850 MB at r = 64, ≈ 210 MB at r = 16); attention-only ≈ 44%
native rank + bf16 ⇒ ≤ 0.5× the fp32 source · L4: rank-32 attention-only adapter, CPU → slot ≤ 10 ms
